title: qa.answer.v1
description: Phase 10 §10.0 wire authority: published by nlp.answer.v1 (direct path) or nlp.proofreader.v1 (post-block/PII-clean path). Consumer = API gateway response stream + cache.v1 + telemetry.v1. Carries the Turkish-language answer, Phase 5 degraded propagation (MUST NOT be silently dropped), tier label for Phase 9 middleware enforcement, and optional citations. Mirrors ai/swarm/agents/nlp/payloads.py::QaAnswerV1.

qa_correlation_id.description: Dispatch correlation id (§10.6); used for fan-out aggregation.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version. v2 adds optional compound-answer support via `parts`. v3 adds answer envelope integrity HMAC and canonical body hash.

envelope_signature_key_id.description: Identifier for the HMAC key used to sign the answer envelope (schema_version 3+).

envelope_signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature over the canonical QA answer envelope (schema_version 3+).

body_canonical_sha.description: SHA256 of the canonical answer body, used by signature verification (schema_version 3+).

kind.description: Optional answer kind for QA answer payloads (e.g. direct, disambiguation, summary, proofreader_blocked, meta.help).

emitted_at.description: Optional emitted timestamp for the answer envelope; duplicate of emitted_at_utc for compatibility when available.

locale.description: Language locale (§10.17). v1 ships tr-TR only; designed to additively gain en-GB/en-US post-Phase-13a.

intent.description: Echoed intent for audit (matches §10.4 closed enum).

answer_text.description: Turkish-language answer string (§10.7 templated + optional §10.8 humanizer).

answer_format.description: Output format (§10.7). markdown_safe = subset safe for rendering without HTML injection. screen_reader = assistive-technology friendly output.

degraded.description: Propagated from predict.approved.v1{degraded} (§10.0 Phase 5 contract). MUST NOT be silently dropped.

degraded_reason.description: Propagated from predict.approved.v1.degraded_reason; null when not degraded.

humanizer_used.description: Whether §10.8 humanizer LLM rephrased the template (false = template-only path).

proofreader_status.description: §10.9 proofreader outcome. `pass` = clean; `blocked` = gate-fail surfaced; `redacted` = PII removed.

tier_id_required.description: Tier gate label from cfg.nlp_intent_tier_map (§10.0 Phase 20). NLP is tier-blind; enforcement is Phase 9 middleware.

request_metadata.description: Optional request provenance metadata preserved through answer production.

preview.description: Operator preview mode flag carried from the originating request metadata.

favorite_team.description: Optional favorite team canonical ID from the user's profile.

shout.description: Optional signal that the original request was an ALL-CAPS shout.

stripped_tail.description: Optional copy/paste tail stripped from the request input for audit tracing.

pragmatic_class.description: Optional question-tag pragmatic class preserved from qa.intent.v1 for proofreader prepend logic.

citations.description: Optional citation block per §10.7 (mandatory for predict.* intents).

prediction_id.description: Present when kind=prediction; round-trips from predict.approved.v1.

source_id.description: Present when kind=source; refers to a Phase 4 storage record id.

produced_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when cited artifact was produced.

model_versions.description: Model version array for kind=prediction (§10.7). Format: predictor_id@semver.

disclosures.description: Optional regulatory disclosures appended to predict.* answers.

disclosure_version.description: Version number for the disclosure text.

disclosure_sha8.description: Stable short hash of the disclosure text.

parts.description: Optional compound-answer parts for multi-subquery requests. Legacy consumers may ignore this and use the first part's body as the top-level answer_text.

body.description: Rendered Turkish answer text for the subquery part.

kind.description: Citation kind for the subquery part.

prediction_id.description: Optional prediction id for kind=prediction citations.

source_id.description: Optional source id for kind=source citations.

produced_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the cited artifact was produced.

model_versions.description: Optional predictor model versions for kind=prediction citations.

calibration_version.description: Optional calibration version for kind=prediction citations.

polarity.description: Resolved answer polarity for the subquery part.

subquery_correlation_id.description: Traceable correlation id for the subquery result.

streaming_chunks.description: Optional streaming answer chunks emitted by the NLP agent before final assembly (§10.25.2 cache coherence).

final_answer.description: Optional final answer text that completes a streamed response (§10.25.2 cache coherence).

emitted_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when answer was emitted (§10.11).

nlp_pipeline_version.description: Semver of the NLP pipeline (§10.11 audit trail).

query_time_bucket.description: Hour-truncated UTC bucket used by the summary top-N cache key.

feature_set_hash.description: Hash of the resolved summary top-N feature set used for cache key stability.
